2) Async + office hours: we record a targeted 20–25 minute walkthrough covering the same scenarios, share the recording + short agenda (attached), and schedule a 30-minute live office hours slot during your Tuesday window for follow-up questions. That gives your team time to digest before the live session.

Proposed slots (Tuesday, Oct 5 local time):
- 09:00–09:45 
- 10:30–11:15 
- 13:00–13:45 (if you land later)

I've attached a compact-demo-agenda.pdf with the flow we suggest. If you prefer the async route, we can record and then hold a 13:00–13:30 office hours.

Let me know which path you prefer and which slot works best. We'll convert the calendar invite accordingly and include Karthik for any deeper technical points.

Cheers,
